title: Recording weekend electricity readings

turns.speaker: S
turns.text: A reminder about the weekend electricity survey. Read the small meter beside the workshop door, not the building meter in the lobby. We need a baseline at six p.m. on Friday, after the last shift clocks out. If a machine is still running a scheduled overtime job, don't stop it for the survey. Take the six o'clock reading anyway, and mark the job on the sheet. A fixed time lets us compare workshops; the job note explains an unusual reading. On Monday, take the second reading before anyone starts a machine. If a machine has already started, record the meter reading and the machine's start time. In that case, leave the weekend-total box empty; the energy team will calculate an adjusted figure.
turns.zh: 提醒大家週末的用電調查。請讀取工作間門旁的小電表，不要看大廳的大樓總電表。我們需要星期五傍晚六點、最後一班打卡下班後的基準讀數。如果有機器還在執行排定的加班工作，不要為了調查而停機。照樣在六點讀表，並在表單註記該項工作。固定時間讀表有助於比較各工作間；加班註記則可解釋異常讀數。星期一要在任何人啟動機器之前讀第二次。如果已有機器啟動，請記下電表讀數與機器的啟動時間。這時請將週末總用電欄留白，能源管理小組會換算調整後的數值。
